# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)

print(f"Number of months: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print(f"MAD: {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {round(mad, 3)}")

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)

for i, v in enumerate(values):
    print(f"  Month {i+1}: {v}")

print(f"\nSum: {sum(values)}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

print("\nAbsolute deviations from mean:")
for v in values:
    print(f"  |{v} - {mean:.4f}| = {abs(v - mean):.4f}")

mad = sum(abs(x - mean) for x in values) / n
print(f"\nMAD: {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded: {round(mad, 3)}")
EOF
